mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_eval_case (scenario, question, keywords, expected_answer, expected_tools, expected_args, expect_clarify, enabled) VALUES (COALESCE(#{scenario}, 'knowledge_qa'), #{question}, #{keywords}, #{expectedAnswer}, #{expectedTools}, #{expectedArgs}, #{expectClarify}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, TRUE))
mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario, question, keywords, expected_answer, expected_tools, expected_args, expect_clarify, enabled, created_at FROM ai_eval_case WHERE enabled = TRUE ORDER BY id
SELECT id, scenario, question, keywords, expected_answer, expected_tools, expected_args, expect_clarify, enabled, created_at FROM ai_eval_case ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_eval_case SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
